Hesuwa Thunderhorn is a tauren pet trainer located on Hunter Rise in Thunder Bluff. When Rexxar is in town, Hesuwa gives Huffer a special jerky. After the Fourth War, Zekhan and Rexxar visited the rise, and the troll ambassador witnessed Huffer charging, tackling, and licking Hesuwa. Hesuwa wouldn't share what specific type of jerky he bribes Huffer with. Zekhan considered him jealous.

Heroic mode (often abbreviated to Heroic or simply HC) refers to a dungeon difficulty setting. This setting is accessed from the party or raid leader's portrait menu; currently the other other difficulty settings are normal mode (the default setting) and challenge mode. Depending on expansion and dungeon type (5-player or raid), the setting has different effects and requirements. For all heroic mode dungeons mobs and bosses have more HP, hit harder, and have additional or more potent skills. Heroic-mode bosses drop better quality equipment than their normal-mode counterparts as well as currency tokens used to purchase epic equipment from vendors. The Hewn Bog is an ogre-infested region located in western Zangarmarsh northwest of Zabra'jin. It is so named because the ogres have chopped down all the region's large mushrooms, leaving behind only hewn stubs. As you can find out when doing quests for Watcher Leesa'oh, the fungal giants that rage in Spawning Glen lost their source of food as the ogres began to chop down the mushroom. As they are starving, they release their fury on the young sporelings of the Spawning Glen.

__NOTOC__ Takes a hex string (must be 6 char long!) and converts it to a RGB percent set (0.0-1.0) local function HexToRGBPerc(hex) local rhex, ghex, bhex = string.sub(hex, 1, 2), string.sub(hex, 3, 4), string.sub(hex, 5, 6) return tonumber(rhex, 16)/255, tonumber(ghex, 16)/255, tonumber(bhex, 16)/255 end

Herrick was one of the right hand men of Danath. He helped oversee the human contingent of the Alliance Expedition which was sent to hunt Ner'zhul. After a tiring march, Herrick and Talthressar decided to mark the location and found Allerian Stronghold. It was an act to commemorate the sacrifices of the Wildhammer dwarves, who had lost Kurdran. According to Talthressar, it was also a symbol of the union between elves, men, and dwarves. Herrick eagerly partook in that morale boosting occasion, and then continued to go on and fight against Vorpil and his Cabal in Auchindoun in their continued search for Ner'zhul. It is unknown what happened to him.

The Heroic Key to the Focusing Iris drops from Sapphiron in the 25-man version of Naxxramas. Although it is a quest item, it must be rolled for, meaning only one person in the raid will be able to loot it, receive the Heroic Key to the Focusing Iris quest, and receive a item Level 226 quest reward item for completing the Judgement at the Eye of Eternity Quest, which involves getting a raid to kill Malygos.

Heroic Fury is a Warrior talent on tier 4 of the Fury tree. When activated, it removes Immobilization effects and refreshes the cooldown of Intercept (Classic). Its primary use is to refresh the 30-second cooldown of Intercept so it can be used multiple times in rapid succession. Alternatively it can be used to break root effects that may hinder the warrior.

Heroic items are upgrades of items that drop in Cataclysm 5-player Heroic mode dungeons, and Wrath of the Lich King (Trial of the Crusader and Icecrown Citadel) and Cataclysm 10-player Heroic mode and 25-player Heroic mode raids. Heroic items have the same name and generally have the same stats, but more of them. Exceptions would be the heroic versions of items that drop in Deadmines and Shadowfang Keep. Normal mode for those instances is tuned for around level 15, while heroic mode is tuned for level 85. Such a massive level difference means that the heroic versions of the items are quite different from the normal versions.

Heroism points referred to points awarded by some dungeons that could be turned in for certain rewards in Cataclysm. They were comparable to today's Emblems; specifically, they were equivalent to the lesser Emblem of Triumph in patch 3.3.0. They have since then been replaced by Justice Points. They would have been added with content patch 4.0.0. Heroism points were only partially implemented in the beta, though the following sources of Heroism points were confirmed by Blizzard: *Trash mobs in normal and heroic 5-man dungeons. *Bosses in all normal and most heroic 5-man dungeons. *When a major content patch is implemented, all Valor points will become Heroism points.

Heroic Elite is a version of an item dropped from an "Elite mode" (informally called "Hard mode") of a raid encounter. The only such encounter is Protectors of the Endless in the Terrace of Endless Spring. The Heroic Elite tag on items, alongside the "Elite" tag, were formalized in the Mists of Pandaria expansion. Before that, items awarded from completing Elite mode encounters were unique to that mode and were not dropped at all if the encounter was completed normally.
